bundle.shortDescription: Animated Pokemon sprites on your desktop
bundle.longDescription: Pick any Pokemon from any game's sprite set, pair it with a trainer on a battlefield, and keep it on your desktop. Sprites and cries are fetched from the community mirrors; nothing is bundled.
